resources.string: Bigger text is easier to read from the sofa
Storage is managed automatically: old programmes are removed every day, logos are capped, and the database is compacted when needed.

Sign in to Plex to watch the films and series on your Plex servers. You can also add a TV service you subscribe to (an Xtream Codes login or an M3U playlist address), or free TV, at any time in Settings › Playlists.

Saves your playlists (with their logins), channel and category choices, favourites, TV guide sources and settings to a file. Copy it with a file manager app to keep it somewhere else. The file isn\'t encrypted, so keep it private.
Only the categories you tick are downloaded, so lists load faster and use less storage.
Its channels, TV guide, films and series are up to date.
